meta.name: red_rock_gulch
meta.prompt: A gold-rush frontier town in a red-rock canyon: false-front saloons on one main street, a stamp mill by the creek, a rail line with a locomotive at a wooden station, an assay office, a boot hill, and the wreck of a crashed airship on the mesa above.

params.brief: A shattered steampunk dirigible wrecked atop the red-rock mesa, its torn canvas envelope exposing twisted brass trusses, cracked steam boilers, a crumpled wooden gondola, and shattered propeller blades embedded in the sandstone.
